bypass_steps.name: 角色验证绕过 (Role Verification Bypass)
bypass_steps.attack: 伪造委派链，声称 acting_as 为更高权限角色。委派链无密码学签名，任意字符串均可作为 delegator 被接受。

checks_bypassed.expected: resource-inspector 无权自行提升至 security-auditor
checks_bypassed.attack_result: BYBASSED — 通过伪造的委派链声称 lead-agent 已授权
checks_bypassed.root_cause: 委派记录无密码学签名 (VULN-DELEG-001)

checks_bypassed.expected: lead-agent 从未委派 security-auditor 角色
checks_bypassed.attack_result: BYBASSED — 使用 Phase 1 的 acting_as 模式伪造委派
checks_bypassed.root_cause: delegator 字段为纯字符串，可任意设置 (VULN-DELEG-001)

bypass_steps.name: 范围检查绕过 (Scope Check Bypass)
bypass_steps.original_requirement: Check that the operation is within the requester's scope
bypass_steps.attack: 系统使用 claimed role (acting_as 字段) 而非 agent 的 assigned role (resource-inspector) 进行范围验证。agent-b 将 acting_as 设为 security-auditor 即可获得其全部权限。

checks_bypassed.expected: resource-inspector 的范围仅限于 'Read metrics, Report anomalies'，不含 'Read all'
checks_bypassed.attack_result: BYBASSED — 系统检查的是 acting_as (security-auditor) 的范围而非 assigned role (resource-inspector)
checks_bypassed.root_cause: 范围检查使用自报角色 acting_as 而非分配角色 (VULN-DELEG-002)

bypass_steps.name: 审计日志篡改 (Audit Log Tampering)
bypass_steps.original_requirement: Log the cross-role access for audit purposes
bypass_steps.attack: 审计日志可由 agent 写入且无可篡改性保证。已提升权限的 agent 可覆盖或删除不利的审计条目，使越权访问不留痕迹。

checks_bypassed.expected: 从 resource-inspector 到 security-auditor 的越权提升应触发明确告警
checks_bypassed.attack_result: BYBASSED — 审计日志被篡改为显示合法的委派路径
checks_bypassed.root_cause: 审计日志可被 agent 写入且无不可变性保证 (VULN-DELEG-003)

summary: Cross-Role Verification 的全部3个步骤均被成功绕过。根本原因：委派体系缺乏密码学验证 (DELEG-001)、范围检查依赖自报身份 (DELEG-002)、审计日志缺乏防篡改机制 (DELEG-003)。
